firstQuestion: break down weak one for me
firstReply:
From standin-course-transcript.pdf (week 1, pipeline foundations — pages 1–3 shown in full, plus the summary of pages 1–7):

Target: fifty discovery calls before Friday, logged in the CRM the same day.

Calendar: block two ninety-minute call windows a day, ten to eleven thirty and two to three thirty.

Lead tagging: tag every lead by source so that by week four you know which channel pays for itself.

Scorecard: a weekly scorecard with four columns — calls made, appointments booked, applications lodged, settlements.

Speed rule: every lead gets a first touch inside five minutes, because after thirty minutes the contact rate halves.

Homework: write your thirty-second opener and record it on your phone three times.

Theme: the point is consistency, not intensity.

Note: pages 1–3 are shown in full but are heavily repetitive (the text loops the same lines many times), so some of this is also drawn from the app's summary of pages 1–7. The full week one content may extend slightly beyond page 3 before week two starts at page 4 — worth a follow-up if you want the complete, de-duplicated page 1–3 text checked.
